run_training_pipeline: run the main training loop for the Listen to Look audio-visual model with argparse CLI
build_audio_preview_lstm: build the audio preview LSTM model using ModelBuilder with image-audio and classifier networks
create_optimizer_with_freezing: create an SGD optimizer with optional image-audio net freezing and differential learning rates
setup_checkpointing: setup the Checkpointer system to save and load model checkpoints during training
validate_model: validate the trained model on the validation dataset and report accuracy and mean average precision
